archetype: dense urban perimeter-block tenement organized around a shared internal courtyard, with street-facing dwelling wings, controlled resident circulation, service access and communal utility space
ground_program: continuous street-facing building edge with one clearly legible principal resident entrance and a separate service or refuse access where footprint permits
entrance vestibule and small resident lobby connecting directly to a protected stair core rather than opening into a private dwelling
ground-floor dwelling units with recognizable kitchen, living, sleeping and sanitation zones arranged around real internal circulation
shared internal courtyard large enough to function as resident outdoor space, daylight well and secondary circulation focus rather than a decorative void
courtyard access from the common circulation system without forcing residents through a private apartment
laundry, boiler, electrical or other communal utility rooms grouped near a service edge and separated from dwelling interiors
refuse and maintenance area with a credible route to the street or alley that does not cross the principal resident lobby
secure storage or caretaker room positioned near shared circulation and service spaces
rear or side emergency egress from the courtyard or secondary stair system where the footprint supports it
terrain feathering, stoops, areaways and drainage that seat the perimeter block into the surrounding street grade without a monolithic raised slab
upper_program: repeatable dwelling bands arranged along exterior and courtyard walls with windows serving actual occupied rooms rather than blind decorative facades
at least two vertically continuous common stair cores for a large perimeter block, each with supported landings, continuous headroom and meaningful destinations
common corridors kept short and legible, with apartment doors opening from shared circulation rather than through neighboring units
dwelling layouts vary enough at corners, stairs and courtyard returns to respond to geometry instead of cloning one rectangular apartment everywhere
upper floors retain a readable hierarchy of living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms and bathrooms with plausible adjacency and circulation
roof access occurs through a real stair-head or maintenance route where rooftop equipment, tanks, vents or laundry structures are present
roof mass follows the perimeter-block wings and courtyard void, preserving a legible urban silhouette rather than capping the whole footprint with one featureless rectangle
circulation: residents move from street entrance to lobby, stair core, common landing or corridor and individual dwelling without crossing service-only rooms
courtyard circulation connects the principal residential wings and at least one secondary egress route while remaining distinct from private dwelling interiors
service staff can reach refuse, utility and maintenance spaces from a service-side approach without hauling waste through the main lobby
every occupied upper floor has a continuous player-scale route to a supported stair and exterior exit direction
stairs, landings, corridor turns and door clearances remain usable at Minecraft player scale with uninterrupted headroom
damage variants must preserve at least one complete street-to-dwelling route and one courtyard-to-egress route
damage_constraints: the damaged derivative must remain recognizable as a perimeter tenement surrounding a shared courtyard rather than degrading into unrelated wall fragments
favor localized fire damage, roof failure, courtyard-wall collapse, failed utilities, boarded units and weather intrusion over repeated rectangular deletion masks
preserve at least one intact stair core and one partially damaged but physically coherent secondary circulation core
where floors collapse, remove or damage the supporting floor, wall and furnishing relationships together so no doors, windows, stairs or fixtures float
retain enough furnished dwelling evidence on multiple levels for the residential program to remain inferable
keep courtyard access, refuse/service logic and communal utilities partially legible even where individual apartments are heavily damaged
allow localized facade shear or corner collapse only where debris, exposed floor edges and surviving support geometry tell the same structural story
derive damaged, occupied or contaminated variants only from this immutable clean master

required_manual_checks: the structure reads immediately as a dense multi-family tenement organized around a genuine internal courtyard
street entrance, common stairs, corridors, courtyard access, dwellings, utilities and refuse/service routes form a believable residential circulation system
dwelling units contain inferable domestic room programs rather than empty repeated cells
stair cores are vertically supported, land on real floors and provide continuous player-scale headroom to every occupied level
courtyard dimensions, openings and surrounding windows make it function as shared resident space and daylight access rather than a decorative shaft
roof geometry and rooftop services are supported by the perimeter wings and reachable where maintenance access is implied
damage remains localized and gravity-coherent while preserving the perimeter-block silhouette, courtyard identity and at least one usable residential route
the building meets street, alley and courtyard grades without floating foundations, buried doors or a rectangular artificial platform
